title: xDrip Missed Reading Issues
symptom: After updating xDrip to version 49817a5-2021.10.04, the user experiences multiple signal missed issues, requiring restart of the collector or disconnecting/reconnecting Bluetooth. Rolling back to version 2021.03.08 resolves the issue. The problem occurs within 90 minutes of installing versions starting from 3b8665e-2021.06.11.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A developer suspects a change in Bluetooth behavior but could not identify it after comparing revisions.
fix: The thread does not provide a fix. The user found that rolling back to xDrip version 3df0152-2021.05.21 resolves the issue, but this is a workaround, not an official fix.
evidence_quote: Have rolled back to 2021.03.08 and it worked again. Tested by upgrading to each release from 8th March, and found they work up to 2021.05.21. After this release, starting with 3b8665e-2021.06.11 missed signals with happen within 90 minutes of installing.
